- Hate-crime law exists; enforcement documented failure (2015 report). Heavier penalties for SO-motivated crimes adopted 28 July 2023.
- Violence: 2008 killing, 2020 assault, 2008 pride attack, 2017 counter-demonstrators. Dated incidents mostly (2008, 2011, 2017, 2020). 2024: death threats to Pride performer; LGBTI youth org institutional checks; asylum-seekers detained.
- Education law Aug 2024 banning "propaganda" of non-traditional orientation and gender identity other than biological — resident/school-facing mostly, but signals state threat-framing of gender identity. That's state hostility framing — axis K.

- Social hostility: documented — far-right, religious institution calling pride sinful, "gender became a slur" 2020-2021.
- Public visibility secured by police presence rather than settled tolerance.

No documented trans-specific killings. Violence documented is anti-LGB (park killing gay men, assault of youths, pride attacks). For a trans visitor, hostile-to-LGBT society transfers somewhat.
